name: What is involved in moving a kitchen sink or dishwasher to a new location?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in moving a kitchen sink or dishwasher to a new location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moving your kitchen sink or dishwasher requires rerouting supply lines and drain-waste-vent piping under the floor. If your home has an accessible basement or crawlspace, adjusting drain lines and tie-ins is relatively direct. However, if your kitchen sits over a finished basement ceiling or on a concrete slab, rerouting plumbing requires cutting into concrete or opening finished lower-level ceilings, which increases labor and patching scope. The new location must also allow proper drain slope and code-compliant plumbing venting out through the roof or nearby vent stacks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moving a sink requires rerouting water supply, drain, and vent lines under the subfloor or slab, requiring adequate drainage slope and clear basement or ceiling access.
